bagPolicy.summary: Only clutches and clear bags up to 10" x 6" x 2" are allowed. All allowed bags are X-ray screened.
allowed: Clear bags up to 10" x 6" x 2"
Medical and childcare bags up to 14" x 14" x 6" (X-ray screened)
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions for medical and childcare needs allow bags up to 14" x 14" x 6" after X-ray screening. Rules may vary by show, so check the event page.

parking.note: Parking is available at the VIP West Garage, Standard East Garage, and Players' Garage. Parking fees vary by event, and garages open approximately four hours before showtime. Purchasing a parking pass in advance is recommended.

rideshare.note: Use the Mobility Hub on the first level of the East Garage, 3700 W Century Blvd. This is the only permitted rideshare pickup and drop-off location on the property.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Intuit Dome varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Additionally, Sensory Bags are available at the Answers Portal located by Section Main 6 on the main level concourse. Please visit the Intuit Dome Mobility Hub located on the first level of our Standard East Garage (3700 W Century Blvd, Inglewood, CA) for rideshare drop off and pickup.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Tickets allow one entry only. Re-entry is prohibited except in an emergency.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Intuit Dome has no traditional box office, so all tickets must be bought online through Ticketmaster or the LA Clippers + Intuit Dome app. Tickets are mobile and appear in the app no later than two weeks before your event; download it, create an account, and complete your profile to access them.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Doors are generally scheduled to open 60 minutes before events. Touring events may use different times. Check the event details before arrival.
